cat > /root/vlan-ansible/playbook.yml <<'EOF'
---
- name: Configure VLAN sub-interfaces on Ubuntu hosts (node2=VLAN10, node3=VLAN20)
  hosts: vlan_hosts
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Install vlan package (802.1q userspace tools)
      apt:
        name: vlan
        update_cache: true

    - name: Ensure 8021q kernel module loads on boot
      lineinfile:
        path: /etc/modules
        line: "8021q"
        create: true

    - name: Load 8021q kernel module now
      modprobe:
        name: 8021q
        state: present

    - name: Render VLAN sub-interface config
      template:
        src: templates/vlan.cfg.j2
        dest: "/etc/network/interfaces.d/vlan{{ vlan_id }}.cfg"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      register: vlan_cfg

    - name: Bring up trunk interface (manual, no IP)
      command: "ip link set dev {{ trunk_iface }} up"
      changed_when: false

    - name: Check current state of VLAN sub-interface
      command: "ip -4 addr show {{ trunk_iface }}.{{ vlan_id }}"
      register: vlan_iface_state
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Bring down VLAN sub-interface before reapplying changed config
      command: "ifdown {{ trunk_iface }}.{{ vlan_id }}"
      when: vlan_cfg.changed and (vlan_ip in vlan_iface_state.stdout)
      failed_when: false
      changed_when: true

    - name: Bring up VLAN sub-interface
      command: "ifup {{ trunk_iface }}.{{ vlan_id }}"
      when: vlan_cfg.changed or (vlan_ip not in vlan_iface_state.stdout)
      changed_when: true

    - name: Verify VLAN sub-interface address
      command: "ip -4 addr show {{ trunk_iface }}.{{ vlan_id }}"
      register: verify_iface
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify route to peer VLAN subnet
      command: "ip route show {{ peer_subnet }}"
      register: verify_route
      changed_when: false

    - name: Assert VLAN interface and route are present
      assert:
        that:
          - vlan_ip in verify_iface.stdout
          - peer_subnet in verify_route.stdout

- name: Configure VyOS (node1) as router between VLAN10 and VLAN20
  hosts: router
  gather_facts: false
  vars:
    trunk_iface: eth1
  tasks:
    - name: Apply VyOS VLAN sub-interface (vif) configuration
      shell: |
        source /opt/vyatta/etc/functions/script-template
